title: Results — Boston Marathon
claims: The 2026 Boston Marathon results page reports 28,506 total results.
The 2026 results include runner, wheelchair, handcycle and duo categories.
John Korir of Kenya is listed first with a half split of 1:01:54 and a finish net time of 2:04:45.
The page links 2026 live tracking and the 2026 results book.
